segments.en: Sorry to keep you waiting.
All right! Let's hit the hangar!
(It should be somewhere around here...)
...Hm? There's a machine over there I've never seen before.
So this is a Jegan-type mobile suit...
Whoa~! First time I've ever seen one this close up!
The machine's balance... looks pretty good.
Hey, hey, isn't it bad news if we get too close?
It's fine, it's fine! We're pilots, after all!
Hey! Wait up, Kaine!
...Well, now that we've come this far, there's no backing out...
Well then, shall we pop open the cockpit?
What are you doing?
Waaah!
Geez, mister! Don't pop out of nowhere like that! You nearly gave me a heart attack!
...And you are?
Lieutenant Kanji Akatsuki and three others, sir!
We're reporting for assignment to the Nahel Argama as of today!
So you're the replacements. I was told you were coming.
I'm Lieutenant Amuro Ray. I'm assigned to the Nahel Argama as well.
I'm supposed to be your instructor, more or less. Good to have you with us!
Pleased to meet you, sir!
Kanji and the Dragonar Team have been assigned to Londo Bell.
So, where's the ship we'll be boarding?
The Nahel Argama is out on an operation, so she isn't here.
She won't put in at Londenion for a while yet.
Then what should we do in the meantime...?
Well, I thought we'd use the time to get some combat training in.
We'll need it so we know what each of us can do, right?
Sounds good!
Let's get started already!
It's an honor to train under you, sir, after all you did in the One Year War!
Cut that out. Here, we're all just fellow pilots.
Are you sure? Go easy on these guys and they'll get full of themselves.
What was that~!!
That's fine. As long as you deliver when it counts, that's all I ask.
I'll go take care of the departure paperwork right away. Until then, you're free to do as you like.
Roger!
Training the moment we arrive, huh? A frontline unit really is something else.
But hey, our new CO seems like a guy you can talk to.
He seems like the serious type, though...
Ah... ignorance is a scary thing...
Huh? What's that supposed to mean?
You guys should learn a little about this world!
You didn't listen properly to Ms. Diane's history lectures, did you?
That stuff's not my department!!
We're counting on you, Light, buddy!
Honestly...!
Listen up! That Amuro guy is a hero of the Federation Forces!
Hmm... a hero, huh? Sounds like training's gonna get interesting.
I'm gonna go do some maintenance on my Dragonar.
Kaine, I'm coming too!
Hey! Wait! Hear me out a little longer, will ya!
Kaine sure is fired up.
Well, I'm going too. Those two might just take off on their own.
Yeah, I'm counting on you.
(Now then... I should do some maintenance on my machine too.)
Lieutenant Amuro Ray, huh...
Even if they call him a hero... it doesn't really mean much to an outsider like me......
Well, Amuro didn't seem to want people making a big deal of it either. I'll just be myself...
The Cloud Saber's maintenance is done... Guess I'll try to "Go Out" for a bit...
...I've only just come to this world, and I don't know a thing...
I need to gather as much information as I can while I'm free to move around...

rows.notes: [2] the thing Kanji is looking for is unspecified in the JP; kept as 'it'. [14] [jp] rendered 'mister' (Kaine addressing a stranger). [16] [jp] read as four in all (Kanji + Kaine, Light, Tapp) -> 'and three others'. [jp] = Captain for both Kanji and Amuro (project uses 'Captain Kanji'). segments.en: (Almost time for training...)
(I didn't turn up much in the way of leads in this town...)
Once you "Depart," the "Combat Drill" will begin.

rows.notes: [2] "Depart" / "Combat Drill" follow the UI strings for [jp] / [jp].

segments.en: Well then, let's get moving already!
Right.
Combat training near the port would agitate the colony's residents.
From now on, we'll hold training away from the colony.
Understoooood!
Listen. In space combat, there's no up or down.
There's no clear line between sky and ground the way there is in ground combat.
Even the same type of machine handles completely differently in space and on the ground. You'd better remember that.
In other words, the tactic of attacking from the "sky" won't work...
Not bad at all.
*pant* *pant*... Far from it...
Amuro... how can you pull off moves like that?
I'm just cutting out wasted motion.
Hey, Kaine... don't you think he's on a whole other level?
Lieutenant Amuro... he really is a hero.
Finally figured it out?
But you know, Kanji's pretty good too.
Guess he wasn't a pro for nothing, huh?
When it counts, that guy delivers...
We'd better catch up quick too...!
That's it for training today. We're heading back.
Roger!
It's been about a month since I came to this... world of stars......
I came here from Claudia, and there's a whole chain of events behind how I ended up here like this...

rows.notes: [1] [jp] read as Kanji modestly brushing off Amuro's praise.

segments.en: Ugh... Where's Omega...? Binzvanker's fleet...?
Dammit... I've lost them completely...
Well... I should just be glad I didn't get taken out in that situation......
The problem is... what to do now.
Still... what is this space......? It's nothing but stars all around...
What's that planet...? And I've never seen a moon like that before...
Did they know...? That there was a space like this beneath the Sea of Clouds?
What?!
Hey, you've gotta be kidding! I'm running low on oxygen?
Right, what about the atmosphere...?
A vacuum? That's impossible!
Dammit! The Cloud System picks now of all times to go down...
This is bad... Oxygen circulation isn't enough. At this rate I'll run out of air.
Diverting all systems... to life support...... As long as the systems don't stop...... I should last... a few days.........
*cough*...... The air's... so thin......
All I can do now is... hope someone... picks me up.........

rows.notes: [0] Omega taken as the glossary character (Kanji's pursuer); 'Where's' kept neutral. [5] [jp] rendered 'that planet' (he is looking at Earth from space; literally 'that star'). | [editorial 7] '!?' -> '?!' (style sheet) | [editorial 10] '!?' -> '?!' (style sheet)

segments.en: This is D-3. Patrol mission complete.
This is D-2! Recon complete here too!
D-1, Kaine here! All three Dragonars, mission complete! We're coming in to land.
Permission to land granted. Please bring it in to Deck 2.
You got it!
Oh, and Ms. Diane, could you have a medical team standing by?
We picked up an unusual machine on the way back.
An unusual machine? You three!
Don't go bringing troublesome things aboard on your own...!
The pilot inside is out cold from lack of oxygen. If you don't hurry, it's gonna get ugly~
On the double, okay? On the double!
That's the deal. We're counting on you, Captain Diane!
Huh? W-Wait a minute...
Sigh...... Me, a captain... How did it ever come to this...
What should we do?
What can we do...? Once those kids say something like that, they won't listen.
Medical team, to Deck 2 immediately! Once the medical team is through, Deck 2 will be temporarily sealed off.
Ugh... Nnngh...
Huh!
Where...? Where am I?!
Oh!
Huh?
Goodness, you startled me. Jumping up all of a sudden like that.
Sorry. Uh...... um...
Ugh... My body won't move the way I want it to.
That's because you jumped up so suddenly...!
Anyway... get some more rest.
Okay, sorry...
I'm Diane Lance. I'm in charge of this ship.
So I'm aboard a ship, then...?
The dock ship La Vie en Rose. The ship that rescued you when you were drifting.
A dock ship? ...So it is a military ship after all?
Well... I suppose that's more or less what it is...
More importantly, won't you introduce yourself?
Ah... My name is Kanji Akatsuki.
Um... As for where I'm from...
What's the matter?
Well, I don't think you'd understand...
Kanji? Nothing you tell me will surprise me, so go ahead.
W-Well...
First, could you tell me how you came to be drifting out there?
(Is it okay to tell her...?)
(But at this rate, I won't get anywhere...)
All right.
...And that's what happened.
So you're saying you "fell" here through that hole in the Sea of Clouds?
Yes, that's right.
You may not believe me, but...
No, I believe you.
Thank you for being honest with me.
Yes... normally, nobody would believe you, would they.
It seems we're in the same boat as you, Kanji.
What do you mean by that?
We're in this universe under circumstances much like yours.
Though I never knew that a place like Claudia, where you came from,
could have the technology to cross over to another world on its own.
We ended up here whether we wanted to or not.
We want to find some way back to our own world, but...
I see...
Kanji, would you put yourself in my care for a while?
At the very least, I should be able to help you get by in this world.
Besides, unless we find this man Binzvanker you mentioned...
it seems we won't be able to get out of this world...
I hardly know anything about Binzvanker myself.
Or what on earth that organization is trying to do...
Let's not rush. We'll start by gathering information together. Our chance will come, I'm sure of it.
Owowowow...
Hey! You're heavy! Get off me, Kaine!
You three! You were eavesdropping!
Honestly... you three...!
We were just worried something might happen to you, Ms. Diane...
Don't give me that!
Aw, what's the big deal? Don't sweat the small stuff so much.
Who are you guys?
We're the Dragonar Team!
We may not look it, but we pilot the Metal Armor Dragonars.
And I'm the leader of the Dragonar Team, Kaine Wakaba!
Hey, Kaine, since when are you the leader?
It's all about the vibe. You just don't get it, do ya.
Sigh... I'm Light Newman. I make up for what these guys lack upstairs.
Whaaat~?!
I'm Tapp! Looks like we're all in the same boat, Kanji. Let's get along!
Uh, y-yeah...
All right! Let's hit the hangar!
Kanji, tell me all about that slick machine of yours!
H-H-H-Hey!
No! Wait, we're not done talking...!
Oh...! Get back here!
Is this really okay? She's the captain, isn't she?
It's complicated. I'll explain later.
Rule of combat! Once you've got a grip on the situation, move fast!!
That's right. Basically, we just gotta nab that Bin-whatsit guy, right?
It's Binzvanker. Do you even get the situation?
(What's with these guys' happy-go-lucky attitude... Is this really okay?)
(...Then again... I'm one to talk.)
And so I came to join up with the Dragonar Team.
It's thanks to them that I can prove who I am in this world now.
The Dragonar D-3 excels at information warfare...
They used that unit's capabilities to the fullest to hack into the Earth Federation's systems.
That was to register themselves as soldiers of the Earth Federation Forces.
And now... we've joined up with Amuro and become part of a frontline unit.
For us pilots, this unit was the best place to gather information.
We decided Ms. Diane would stay with the supply unit and gather information from another angle.
The supply unit was also handy for getting the special supplies the Dragonars and my FT need.
After that, we spent day after day doing nothing but training.
The more I trained with Amuro, the better I understood why Light called us "ignorant."
Amuro's piloting sense was so far beyond ours, there was simply no comparison.
Kanji. Hey, Kanji! You listening?
Huh? What is it?
Gaaah... I can't just say it all over again now!
Huh?
Wahaha! He totally left you hanging!
No need to play along with his lame jokes.
Haha... Sorry, Kaine.
Eh, whatever. Just don't space out so much.
We're outsiders here. You'd better keep your eyes open.
Yeah... I'll be careful.
Come to think of it, they said the Nahel Argama's putting into port today.
Hey, Light, when's she getting here?
No idea on the details! It's a military secret, after all...
Can't you just hack into the military's system?
You make it sound so easy.
Listen, even within Londo Bell, the Nahel Argama's movements are the hardest to pin down.
It all depends on Captain Bright's judgment. That's the kind of unit it is.
(So we're finally being deployed for real...)
(Anyway, right now my first priority is getting used to space...)

segments.en: Another ship's coming in. Got a trace on it?
On it. Turning on the guide lights.
The Nahel Argama, you say?
Yes, no mistake.
That's unsettling... Is there gonna be a riot in this colony or something?
How should I know!
Hey! A ship's coming in!
Ah, yes sir!
We're dealing with Londo Bell. Watch what you say.
Colony guide lights confirmed!
No suspicious objects near the gate!
Good, maintain speed!
Security team, don't forget to tighten security once we're in port.

rows.notes: [0] [jp] read as 'trace' (tracking the incoming ship).

segments.en: The Nahel Argama... She's here?
A bit ahead of schedule...
Ah, hold on. Unauthorized personnel aren't allowed in here...
Hm?
Ah, my apologies! Lieutenant Amuro!!
Keep up the good work on watch! I'll be coming through.
Not many MS here... Some must be out on patrol...
Meaning they need to keep a tight guard...
Amurooo!!
Hm?
Chan! It's zero-G!
Ah!
Are you all right?
Ah, yes.
Be careful. You're an important mechanic.
Thank you.
Oh, Lieutenant, your machine's maintenance is done, so could you take a look at it now?
All right.
How is it?
Nice. It's well tuned.
Thank you.
But this is about as far as a Jegan can go.
You're doing a great job, Chan.
More importantly, could you take a look at the new pilots' machines?
About that...
That machine... its structure is completely different from any Federation machine so far.
I can't even tell who made the parts...
Still, it isn't a Zeon machine, is it?
It's best not to dig too deep into that.
But, Amuro...
They're pilots Londo Bell can't do without right now. Look after them for me.
If you say so, Amuro...
I'm going to see Bright. I'll leave the rest to you.
Okay.
You've joined up with the Nahel Argama.

rows.notes: [29] Amuro's [jp] read as 'still/even so': he knows it isn't Zeon-made either. | [editorial 0] style sheet: ship names take she/her

segments.en: Been a while, Amuro. You look well.
I had a rough time of it down on Earth.
More importantly, you've got quite a lot of guards posted outside.
Londo Bell is a nuisance wherever it goes.
I thought Londenion was friendly toward Londo Bell?
Believe it or not, this is less security than usual.
In space, you never know where Zeon sympathizers might be hiding.
Neo Zeon lost its leader, Haman, in the battle at Core 3...
But not all of its soldiers surrendered.
That's right...
I hear the Federation Forces carried out sweeping mop-up operations on Earth...
Yes, but Neo Zeon got the better of us...
In Western Europe, we let quite a large force escape into space.
They must be hiding out in a colony somewhere.
Do you think the rumors that Char is back are true?
At the very least, the Neo Zeon remnants believe it and are fighting for it...
Char once fought alongside us as a member of the AEUG.
And now he's going to lead Neo Zeon and rise up?
His whereabouts have been unknown since the Gryps War.
If he meant to go on living as Quattro of the AEUG, he could've shown himself to us, couldn't he?
So you think Char is out there somewhere, biding his time...
Whatever he's planning... we have to get a handle on it as soon as possible...
In the end, all we can do is go around searching the colonies one by one.
...So that's why the current settings aren't suited for space combat.
Huh, I see. That's helpful.
I'm starting to get a good feel for this machine, too.
So it's fine, right? Let me help with your machine's maintenance from now on.
Ah... well... that's a different matter...
Geez! What do I have to do to get you to trust me?
Even if you put it that way...
What's going on?
Oh, Lieutenant... well...
Kanji, leave the maintenance to Chan. We're shipping out right away.
Shipping out? Where to?
Every colony in the Earth Sphere.
Chan! Get all units tuned so they're ready for real combat right away!
Ah, yes!
That's settled, right, Kanji?
...Okay. I'm counting on you.
Honestly, what a handful you are.
Well, I'll go adjust the other machines.
Well, can't be helped. It's not like I could keep it hidden forever...
(Now then... maybe I'll head into town again...)

rows.notes: [7] [jp] -> 'Core 3' and [18] [jp] -> 'Gryps War': not in glossary. [38] Chan's [jp] rendered 'That's settled, right, Kanji?'. | [editorial 37] 'sir' added; Chan addresses Amuro casually, matches her 'Ah, yes.' at r10 [15] (accuracy flag)

segments.en: Yo! Kanji! Over here!
Hm? What's up?
Speak of the devil, here he is.
What's going on?
Actually, Kanji... sorry to spring this on you, but there's a job I'd like to leave to you.
What do you need me to do?
From now on, Kanji, I'd like you to handle "Squad Setup."
...Huh?
Me, handle Squad Setup? I can't just do that out of nowhere!
You're the senior officer, Amuro, so naturally Squad Setup should...
I can't always be on the ship.
So I want to leave Squad Setup to someone in the field.
Isn't there anyone else better suited?
We're short on properly trained officers.
Your rank of lieutenant isn't just for show, is it, Kanji?
Ugh...
Don't worry, you can do it. You've got experience, right?
Well, yeah, sort of...
Whoa, whoa! Don't look at me! I'm no good at this!
That kind of thing is exactly what I'm worst at.
Kaine... in your case, you don't know enough to begin with.
Tch! Yeah, yeah, I was the Academy washout, all right!
But hey, it's a good chance! Give it a shot, Kanji!
Yeah... All right, I'll give it a try.
Good. Then let's start the lecture right away. I'll boot up the system.
Now beginning the explanation of "Squad Setup."

rows.notes: "Squad Setup" follows the UI menu string for [jp]. | [accuracy 15] [jp] = Lieutenant (owner decision 2026-11-01, term_fixes.json); term script only catches 'Captain Kanji', not 'rank of captain' | [editorial 19] '!?' -> '?!' (style sheet) | [editorial 22] 'before that, in your case you just...' was clumsy; [jp] = to begin with | [editorial 23] 'Alright' -> 'All right' (style sheet)

segments.en: First, select "Squad" from the menu.

rows.notes: [jp] menu label not found in UI strings; 'Squad' chosen to match 'Squad Setup'.

segments.en: This is the screen where you choose "Mech Squad" or "Infantry Squad."
Currently, only a "Mech Squad" can be set up.
Now select "Mech Squad."

rows.notes: [jp] / [jp] -> Mech / Infantry Squad, following UI strings.

segments.en: Next is the squad selection screen.
Here, you can register multiple squads.
Let's go ahead and create a new squad.
Select "New Squad," second from the top.

rows.notes: "New Squad" = UI string for [jp].

segments.en: Next, give the squad a name.
When you've finished naming it, select "Confirm."
From here, you'll set up what goes into the squad.
First, choose the battleship that will serve as the mothership.
Right now, the only choice is the "Nahel Argama."
Select the "Nahel Argama."
Next, choose the "Units" and "Equipment" to load.
First, let's try adding a "Unit."
Select the spot marked "FREE" on the left.

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Unit(s)' (UI uses 'Units'); [jp] -> 'Equipment' (UI tab is 'Equip').

segments.en: A list of the "Units" you currently own is now shown.
First, try selecting the "Jegan."
Next, put a "Pilot" in the selected "Unit."
Choose a "Pilot" who can fly "Type: MS."
The "Jegan" is "Type: MS." First, put "Amuro" aboard.

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Type' (UI string).

segments.en: The unit has now been loaded onto the battleship.
Can you see that the "FREE" area has shrunk by the unit's size?
In other words, the "FREE" area shows the free space in the mothership's hangar.
Follow the same steps to add "Units" and "Equipment" and form your squad.
When you're finished with Squad Setup, press the X button.
The new squad you created has now been registered.
Finally, choose whether to make this squad your "Sortie Squad."
The "Sortie Squad" is the squad actually used in battles against the enemy.
If that's fine, select "Yes."
If you're not confident in your setup, select "No."

rows.notes: "Sortie Squad" = UI string for [jp].

segments.en: The squad whose name is shown in yellow is the currently selected squad.
This concludes the Squad Setup tutorial.
Press the X button to exit.

rows.notes: [0]-[1] match the existing UI translations of the same strings.

segments.en: Well? Do you get the gist of it?

I don't think I'll really get it
until I've had more experience...

No need to rush. Even the current
formation should work well enough.

Only try changing the formation when you
really feel you need to.
Thanks. I'll get used to it as fast as I can.
You are now ready to "Depart."
"Squad Setup" is now available.

Also, through the training so far,
the Dragonar Team has learned
"MS Piloting."
From now on, they can board "MS" units.
Well, it's finally time to set sail.

Until we reach the next port, we won't
be able to set up squads or record data...
I'd better get ready while I still can!

rows.notes: Menu terms in quotes follow the UI strings: [jp] = "Depart", [jp] = "Squad Setup". Seg 5 [jp] rendered as being ready to "Depart". Segs 9-11 headerless after Kanji's line kept as Kanji. | [accuracy 3] restricting dake restored: change the formation ONLY when really needed ('Just' read as 'simply') | [proofread 5] punctuation inside closing quote (unit/corpus convention) | [proofread 7] punctuation inside closing quote (unit/corpus convention)

segments.en:
From here on, this ship will thoroughly
survey every colony and resource satellite.
Display the destination markers.
Displaying markers.

Our objective is to keep needless
war from spreading.

We learn Neo Zeon's moves in advance and
stop the fighting before it starts.
Don't forget that.
Now, commence operations!

rows.notes: Segs 1, 4, 5 headerless: Bright's orders (seg 1 answered by the operator).

segments.en: Ngh, we've been spotted!

Not now...
Withdraw from the front at full speed!

Impossible! The enemy already has
a lock on us!

Blast it! We have no choice!!
MS squad, launch!
Hey, Amuro! Where are you headed?

To check on the new machine. I'm leaving
the info-gathering in town to you.
Yeah, got it.
How far along is my Nu Gundam?

I'd say about 70%.
It's almost there.

No... I need you to cut another
10 days off the delivery date.

That's impossible! We haven't even
finished assembling it yet!

And the balance tuning can't be done
until the whole thing is put together.
The checks on the test unit are done.
Just build it exactly according to this data.

...I'll do what I can,
but I can't make any guarantees.

Sorry about this...
Chan! Fly ahead to La Vie en Rose.

I know. I just need to have the Re-GZ's
maintenance finished, right?
Right.

So that's the deal.
Get a shuttle ready for me!

You're a busy bunch, aren't you?
Understood. I'll have one prepared
right away.

Mind you, it's a cargo model.
I can't vouch for the comfort.
That's fine.

In exchange, keep the Nu Gundam work
going while I'm away, okay?

We'll do our very best.
Well then!

Hey, Amuro...
Is Char making his move?
He's already moving.
What I don't know is how he'll come at us.
I see...
Well, I'll go on ahead.
Sorry about this. I'm counting on you.
Hehe! No problem.

Don't forget our date on your
next day off~

Hey...!
Chan, shh~...!
Ahaha!
Honestly...

Chan has left the unit
and is now acting separately.

rows.notes: Seg 24 (headerless '......') kept as a bare pause; could be Chan or Amuro. Seg 5: [jp] read as 'cut ten days off the deadline'.

segments.en:
I didn't feel like asking with other
people around, but...
What happened with Beltorchika Irma?
We split up.
I see...
She's a perceptive girl.
I don't demand anything of her, but...

I guess she sensed that even without saying
it, I expect a lot from women.

Yeah... somewhere deep down, you do make
those kinds of demands.
A mother complex?
I admit it.

I hold it in, but Beltorchika
can tell anyway.

So instead, it only ends up making her
more frustrated...

She's not so much perceptive
as she is strong.

I heard a rumor she was with Karaba,
about three years ago...

She's left Karaba too now.
She should be in South America.
You don't even write to each other?
No...
How's Mirai doing?

She's fine. She was in Lhasa,
but I've got her getting ready to move.
You're bringing her up to space?

I've had enough of Earth... Hathaway and
Cheimin are only getting more conservative.
But it hasn't been going smoothly...

I had a hard time even getting
tickets up to space.

Why? Surely someone like you,
Bright...

They don't let dangerous elements
go up into space.

I see... The Federation General Staff
believes you're a Newtype too, Bright.

I can't really blame them. It's a fact
that I commanded a Newtype unit.

Well... I guess I have Kai Shiden to thank
for the tickets? Even then, who knows
when they'll be revoked...

By the way...
Haven't you gone to see Fraw Bow?

Give me a break...
How am I supposed to face her?

What happened to Hayato in the last war...
I feel terrible about it.

But you can't avoid her forever.
Well, that's the responsibility
of those who survived.

Yeah...
Once this fight is settled,
I'll go see her properly.

rows.notes: Headerless pages assigned by alternation: 1 Bright; 5-6, 9-10 Amuro; 12 Bright; 20-21 Bright; 26 Bright; 29 Amuro. Seg 29 [jp]: Amuro's regret over Hayato's fate (seg 30 implies Hayato did not survive); kept as 'I feel terrible about what happened', not an explicit death. Names not in glossary: Beltorchika Irma, Karaba, Mirai, Lhasa, Cheimin, Fraw Bow (standard Gundam spellings). Hayato here is Hayato Kobayashi, not the glossary's Hayato Kazami. | [editorial 10] awkward 'building up her frustration'; same meaning and referent, smoother spoken phrasing | [editorial 22] 'You're Bright, you should...' read oddly; natural trailing form of buraito nara... | [editorial 29] dangling 'Hayato in the last war...' fragment; reordered for clarity, keeps the vague who-was-at-fault reading set at accuracy

segments.en:
So this is Luna II.
Let's take a look at the port.

Pretty lifeless for an active
military port...

Maybe the Nahel Argama isn't welcome
here either.

Hm...?
Someone's coming...

Heeey!
You there!
You mean me?

Haven't seen your face around...
Are you really with Londo Bell?
Yeah, I am.
I'm Lieutenant Kanji Akatsuki.

Whoa! My bad, then.
So you're a lieutenant, huh?

Your uniform's different,
so I couldn't tell.

Lieutenant JG Kayra Su, sir!
I'm a pilot with Londo Bell!

I can tell just by looking.
I'm a pilot too. Good to meet you!

Pleased to meet you,
Lieutenant Kanji!

Just call me Kanji. Looks like you're
my senior when it comes to space anyway.
You sure?

That's how it is between pilots, right?
You only need formal talk for reports.

Ah... though maybe that was just
my old unit.

Got it.
Gotta obey a superior's orders, after all.

That's the spirit!
Good to have you, Kayra!

Heh...
Looks like you and I are
gonna get along just fine.
Kayra has joined the unit.

Machine added:
Jegan x1
Kayra, you were here?
Lieutenant!

Luna II investigation mission
complete, sir!

Sorry to put you through that.
So, how did it go?
This isn't really the place...

Got it...
We'll talk on the bridge.
...You're coming too, right, Kanji?
Yeah...
...That concludes my report.

So far, there's no sign of any
Neo Zeon sabotage. However......

As things stand, Luna II's defenses
are inadequate... is that it?

Federation HQ did answer our call to
strengthen the defenses... but it seems
the "results" haven't followed.

The defense forces have been
increased, at least...
But not the quality, right?

Quality?
You mean their training?

There's plenty of them, all right. But half
are reserve ships on the verge of retiring
and a pack of thrown-together troops...

There's old-generation nukes and
important facilities here, right?
Is that really good enough?
It sure isn't...

I'll petition them again about
strengthening the defenses.

We'll keep a ship under direct Londo
Bell command posted at Luna II.

Kayra, transfer to the Nahel Argama
as planned.
Roger!

We set sail as soon as
preparations are complete.

Kanji,
I'm leaving the squad
reorganization to you!
Yes, sir!

Kanji's the one in charge
of squad setup?
That's what I'd like to know.

I've only just joined the unit,
you know.

Well, you are a lieutenant,
sort of.

So anyway, if you've got any
complaints, tell me right away.

Not that I think I'm cutting
any corners, though.
Hmm, I see...
Wh-What?

You might be more reliable
than you look.

Well then,
I'm counting on you.

rows.notes: Kayra drops -kun/-san: [jp] rendered as teasing 'captain', [jp] as plain 'Kayra'. Seg 26 '[jp]' is Kayra to Amuro (also a captain). Seg 43 [jp] = a Londo Bell ship stationed at Luna II. Seg 58 headerless: Kayra continuing. Luna II not in glossary. | [accuracy 11] rank: taii = Lieutenant (owner decision in term_fixes); 'captain' contradicted Kanji's 'Lieutenant Kanji Akatsuki' on the previous page | [accuracy 52] rank: taii-san = Lieutenant (owner decision), consistent with pages 10/15 | [editorial 29] 'Not here, it's...' was clumsy; natural reluctant form of koko de wa, chotto... | [editorial 50] 'I kinda wish someone would tell me that myself' was clunky; idiomatic equivalent of kocchi ga kikitai kurai da

segments.en:
What's that?
An airlock alarm?
Is somebody launching...?
It's Lieutenant Amuro...
Something up?

Yeah...
I'm heading out for a bit of recon.

I'm sensing a strange shadow...
It might be a fleet.
Anything on IFF?
I haven't tried, but...

Either way, they're not going to
answer us, are they?
Should we head out too?

No, it's fine...
I'll go take a look by myself
for now.

How should I put it... It's still just...
something like a hunch of mine.
I don't want to cause a big fuss.
Well, I'm off.
Colonel......

Hm...?
What is it? Why are you whispering?

A mobile suit has launched from the
Nahel Argama.
Have we been spotted?
It's hard to say...
Hmm... I see...

I'll go out myself.
Have the Sazabi prepared.

Call it a test...
It wouldn't do for the men to
catch on, would it?

Making a fuss would be like telling
the enemy where we are.

Above all, the crew is still
a group of amateurs...

Good judgment.
That's exactly why I'm going out alone.
Colonel... where are you going?
Reconnaissance.
You, personally, Colonel?

I told you the Earth Federation Forces
were coming to Sweetwater, didn't I?

Ah...
Londo Bell?

It seems Amuro's with that unit,
and he's come to see me.
Your usual intuition, Colonel?
Yes...

Why, though? I understand your theory
of remaking the Earth, but
why do you hate Amuro so much?

I don't hate him,
but I find myself wanting to fight him.
Because you're two of a kind?
Hmph... He's soft.
Is he?

To me, Amuro only ever seemed
like a good comrade-in-arms
of yours, Colonel.

...Perhaps it pains me to see him
at the beck and call of those
Earth Federation types?

Amuro Ray might even become
Prime Minister someday, you know?

Even so...
Humanity has no precedent of
successful reform from within.

It's been a mere century since
humanity's true space emigration began.

Yet among the Spacenoids, a generation
has grown that thinks of Earth as
nothing but one more planet.

Are you saying that indifference
has made the Earth Federation
government self-righteous?

Yes... That's why I want to make
the Spacenoids remember that
the Earth exists.

And in the distant future, when the
Spacenoids remember Earth as
humanity's home,

I don't want it to still be an Earth
defiled by the Oldtypes.

I want it to be a warm Earth, wrapped
in nature as it has been since
ancient times.

To that end, I cannot forgive the
arrogance of those who keep the
Earth to themselves.
Someone like me must purge them...
I understand how you feel, but...

If the psycommu were strong enough to
instill humility in all of humanity,
there'd be no problem...

So... you'll carry out the
Earth-cooling operation after all?

Yes...
Telling fairy tales is what
the incompetent do.

That's why I will purge those
who insist on clinging to the Earth.

Humanity can't grow wise
that easily.

I'm sorry, but
I'm short on time.
Let's leave it at that.
Ah, I'm sorry.

The operation is near.
See to Gyunei's adjustments.
Yes, sir!

(Amuro Ray...
 I won't be at peace until
 we settle things someday...)

(If the fight between Amuro and me
 simply ended with us both growing old...
 that's one outcome I won't allow...)

(And if this should cost me my life,
 then that too is fate...)

rows.notes: Headerless seg 5, 8, 11-12 Amuro; 19-20, 23 Char; 21-22 Lyle (gender unknown, addressed neutrally); 32-33, 37-38 Nanai; 45-50, 52, 55-57 Char; 53, 58 pauses. Seg 6 [jp] = IFF. Seg 54 [jp] = 'Earth-cooling operation'. Seg 39 kept as Char's rhetorical self-question. Sweetwater not in glossary. | [editorial 29] stiff relative clause in Char's line; smoother, same meaning

segments.en:
Hm?
The Minovsky particles are
getting denser...!

An MS is moving... Just one.
They're scouting too... I doubt they mean
to attack in earnest...

It's him!
He's here... but why?

Is he...
calling me...?

Char?!
So you were alive after all!

Hmph...!
As if I'd lose my life fighting
a mere woman like Haman Karn!

You've got some nerve! You can't
pretend you don't know you drove
Kamille mad!

Sensitivity is no virtue,
Amuro!

Look at the masses and the bureaucrats!
Do they go mad?

No matter what happens,
they just go on living, unfazed!

Those who think their talent excuses
their fragility end up swallowed
by the masses!
That's reality!

So you're saying you were hiding,
swallowed by the masses too?

Say what you like. I'm sick and tired
of humanity's stupidity!
That's why I'll crush the Earth!
What did you say?!

I'll erase the Earth Federation
government -- all of humanity
on the Earth!

And I'll stake humanity's rebirth
on the Spacenoids!
Don't be ridiculous!

You understand, surely. This is an age
when humanity must atone to the Earth
and to space itself!
People aren't that arrogant!

They die in floods, they die in volcanoes,
they die from a little cold or heat!

Creatures like that can't possibly
be arrogant toward nature!

They grew too frightened! Humanity used
science to defend itself, but it went
far beyond self-defense!

Just how long do humans have to live
before they're satisfied?

They call living to a hundred a given,
but that's just a desire born in the
last two or three hundred years!

Before that, humans were creatures that
couldn't even live fifty years!

Unless humanity casts off its arrogance,
it'll devour even the space colonies!

You're saying people wanting to live
isn't the truth?!
Don't twist the argument, Amuro!

Gihren Zabi of the Principality of Zeon
killed five billion, yet humanity still
outnumbers the old era's population.

Humanity's numbers are no lighter,
and its spirit is as rigid as ever!
I cannot forgive that!
So you'll crush the Earth?

Fighting the Titans alongside you
was a good lesson for me.

I learned that even if you became a
politician and tried reform from
within, it would be impossible.

In fact, all you do is scurry around
like a rat inside the Earth
Federation Forces!
Ngh...

...I've had it with the people
of Earth.

...But what brought me here now, to you,
my rival of old and once my friend,

was my friendship -- I felt I had to
tell you in person!

How presumptuous! If you mean to
crush the Earth, I'll stop you!

Splendid! A man with that spirit
is a true friend of mine!
He's gone...

Amuro!
Good work out there!
Ah... yeah...
Did something happen?
No... it's nothing...

Char...
He doesn't even have a real army...

So how does he plan to
crush the Earth...?

rows.notes: Headerless pages in the argument assigned by alternation (9-12, 22-23, 25-28, 31-32, 35, 39-40 Char; 16 Amuro). Seg 17 [jp] kept as an appositive ('the Federation government -- humanity on Earth'). Seg 29 [jp] rendered 'people wanting to live isn't the truth'. Seg 40 split from seg 39 at the same point as the Japanese. Gihren Zabi, Principality of Zeon, Titans: standard spellings (Titans from glossary unit names).

segments.en:
Kanji,
find anything?

No...
Nothing useful.

Still, the environment in this colony
isn't so great compared to the others.

It's a rush-built colony...
Compared to Londenion,
it's not well maintained.
Seems that way...

There are still places I want
to look into.

If anything comes up,
contact me right away.

Got it.
Well, I'll be off, then.

Kanji...
doesn't seem to know much about
what colony life is really like...
Hm, what's that?

This feeling...
It's not Char...
A cyber-Newtype...?!

Ngh...
What is this pressure?

What's wrong?
Gyunei Guss.
It's nothing...

That's all right.
Tell me what you felt.
I sense... some other power...

Nanai...
Is he all right?

This pattern is most likely...
resonance with another Newtype.

Londo Bell is in this colony
right now, so...
Then stop it at once.

We can't let them catch on
to our movements now.
Understood.

Gyunei,
the test is canceled.
Leave this place immediately.
Yes, ma'am!

He'd better be ready in time
for the operation!

No need to worry.
...Now, if you'll excuse me!

You can't go through,
Mr. Amuro!

Past this point, even Londo Bell
personnel can't go through without
the proper paperwork.

There's a spaceport up ahead.
I just want to check it out.

P-Please, give me a break.
I can't decide that on my own.

Anyway,
I'll go get my supervisor, so...
Damn it!

There's no point in waiting
here any longer.
I'd better head back to the ship.

rows.notes: Seg 6 headerless: Amuro continuing. Seg 11 [jp] = 'cyber-Newtype' (matches Gyunei's glossary description). Seg 19 [jp] rendered as plain 'Nanai'. Seg 27 [jp] to Nanai rendered 'Yes, ma'am!'. Seg 30 [jp] -> 'Mr. Amuro'. Seg 37 [jp]: Amuro alone -> 'I'd better head back'. Londenion not in glossary.

segments.en:
Yo! Kanji,
you done over there?
Yeah, I'm free right now.

Then how 'bout hearing us out
for a bit?
Sure.

We've been all around the colony, but
we didn't get much useful info...

Yeah... Is there even any point
in staying with this unit anymore?

But hey, thanks to a good instructor,
we're getting some training out of it.

Well, sure, but that ain't
what we're here for, is it?

It wasn't a waste. Going around all these
colonies got me the material I needed.

Material?
What're you on about?

Info I need to dive deeper
into the network.
I'm almost onto something.
Neo Zeon's movements?

It's not clear yet,
but something's going to happen...
You mean a war's gonna start?
Probably...

Right...
Then I'm leaving the digging to you.

Not that we could stop a war
with just our own strength...
Well, I'll do what I can.

rows.notes: Seg 11 and 18 headerless: Light continuing. Seg 18 [jp] could also be Kanji closing the scene; kept as Light. Seg 5: [jp] = Londo Bell, which the Dragonar team is attached to.

segments.en:
Captain Bright,
a message from HQ.
Put it through here.
Roger!

I see...
So the new Ra Cailum
has been completed.

We can take delivery of her
at Londenion.
What will you do, sir?

Set a course for Londenion
immediately.
Roger!

rows.notes: Seg 4 headerless: Bright continuing.

segments.en:
Well?
How's the Ra Cailum?

We haven't taken her into combat yet,
so I can't say for sure, but I think
she's a fine ship.

The Nahel Argama was a powerful ship,
but she was ill-suited to fleet
operations.

In that regard, the Ra Cailum is far
more capable as a fleet flagship.

With this, Londo Bell will be able to
show its full capabilities as a
mobile task force.

...But what concerns me is that the
Nahel Argama is being decommissioned.

Our new ship has no
High Mega-Particle Cannon...

That cannon can do fatal damage
to a colony in a single shot.

It's bound to provoke
the colony citizens.

True...
Considering the colonies...

But surely there's no need to put
the Nahel Argama in the reserves
at a time like this?

Right now, we're updating equipment:
GM-types to Jegans, and Salamis-types
to Clop-class ships.

The costly Argamas and Gundams are being
phased out of the front-line units.
Please bear with it, Bright.

Understood. Then in an emergency,
please press the Federation Forces
on our behalf.

I know. I'll keep serving as your
line to Federation Forces HQ.
Thank you, sir.
Now, if you'll excuse me!

The "Ra Cailum" has been assigned
to Londo Bell.

The "Nahel Argama" has been
decommissioned from Londo Bell.

rows.notes: Headerless segs 3, 6, 8, 10, 12-13, 17 assigned by alternation (3, 8, 12-13 official; 6, 10, 17 Bright). Seg 6 [jp] -> 'High Mega-Particle Cannon' (built from glossary Mega-Particle Cannon). Seg 13 [jp] -> plain 'Bright'. Seg 11 [jp] = GM-type, [jp] = Salamis-type. | [editorial 9] 'If we think of the colonies' sounded unnatural for Bright's agreement | [proofread 2] style sheet: ships take she/her (Nahel Argama; matches Ra Cailum in 34/4, 35/1)

segments.en:
We'll be setting out soon.
I'll wait in my room.

So this is the new ship,
the "Ra Cailum"...

The interior isn't all
that different...

Hm?
What's that call?

What is it...
I'm being called to the bridge...

Captain Bright,
you called for me?

Yes. Sync the Squad Setup
system with the bridge.

Kanji! Over here.
Give this a quick check.
Coming!

(System check complete.
 Well, that should do it...)

You seem to be getting
used to things lately.

It's a brand-new ship...
Lots of things are handier now,
so it's easier to work with.

Hm?
What's going on?

Hey!
Something huge just happened!!

What's wrong?
Why the panic...
Neo Zeon is on the move!
What?!

Hold on,
where did you get this info?

My machine's got all sorts of
features, so... um,
I did a little hacking...

I don't mind.
Go on.

Understood.
Then I'll explain from the start.

Just a moment ago, Sweetwater in Side 3
declared independence as Neo Zeon.

Their declaration of independence
will be broadcast soon.

Neo Zeon's declaration of independence?
It's Char!

That's right.
But the declaration that's about
to start is a diversion.

A diversion?
What do you mean?

A trick to make us think Char
is at Sweetwater, right?

Yeah...
Their target is
Fifth Luna.

The Neo Zeon fleet has
already sortied.

Fifth Luna...
That's it!

He means to drop Fifth Luna
onto the Earth!

Drop it on Earth...
But what for...?
I'll get that out of him myself!

Light!
Do you know the enemy fleet's strength?

The battleship "Rewloola,"
plus a bunch of Musaka-class cruisers...
All of them brand-new ships.

This is bad...
Londo Bell's fleet is scattered
all over the place.

We're critically short on
strength on our own.

But there's no time to gather the fleet
at Londenion.
We should set out right away.

Right.
We'll assemble the fleet with
La Vie en Rose as our base.

Call in our fleets from
every sector, immediately!

All hands, battle stations!
Ra Cailum, launch!!

rows.notes: Seg 2 headerless: Kanji continuing. Seg 6 [jp] = the Squad Setup system (UI term). Seg 21: the source places Sweetwater in Side 3; kept. Seg 28, 30, 37 headerless assigned to Light / Amuro / Amuro by context. Fifth Luna, Side 3 not in glossary. | [proofread 34] comma inside closing quote (unit/corpus convention)

segments.en: I am Char Aznable,

son of Zeon Deikun, who once called for the
awakening of mankind and the independence
of the Spacenoids.

Carrying on my father's will, I hereby
declare the independence of Neo Zeon!
So it's begun.

Yeah. And somehow, the reception's
crystal clear.
Heh~ So this guy's Char, huh?
Hey, let me see too!

If mankind keeps clinging to the Earth,
not only the Earth but humanity itself
will perish.

Mankind must leave the nest of its
mother, the Earth!

Yet the present Federation government will
never abandon its stance of clinging to
the Earth.

Therefore, we of Neo Zeon shall commit our
full strength to freeing all mankind from
the Earth's gravity!

I see. So the operation for that
is a meteor drop, huh.

That's a whole different league from
hitting the Earth with a mass driver.

Whatever his reasons, nobody's gonna just
say "Oh, okay, sure" to that.
So this is Neo Zeon...

The ones we're going to have
to fight as our enemy...

rows.notes: Seg 4: Light picked up the broadcast by hacking (previous row 36), hence the joke about reception. Sweetwater spelled as in the UI map names (elf_ui); library entries also have 'Sweet Water'.

segments.en:
We've arrived in La Vie en Rose's
sector.
How's the fleet assembly going?
Checking now!

The planned fleet assembly is nearly
complete.

Hurry them up.
The enemy won't wait for us!

Bright, can't we get fleet support from
the Federation Forces?
They say they can't spare any ships.

They're probably afraid of riots
in the colonies.
I'm going to pick up the new machine.

As soon as each ship's resupplied,
the fleet sorties!
Have everyone get ready!

rows.notes: [editorial 8] consistency: shingata = 'new machine' as in 27/1 of the previous unit; 'new model' read like a product line

segments.en: ...And these are the Re-GZ's specs.

I tested the actual unit myself, just in
case. It matches the data almost exactly.
I see. Looks like it'll do.
Hahaha! There's no beating you, Chan.

Checking everything yourself, over
and over again.

I do wish you'd trust the Anaheim staff
a little more.

You moved the delivery date up for us, so
I just did what I could myself.

With this, it looks like we'll make it in
time for the next operation.

Yeah, you've been a big help...
Are we all set on the remaining paperwork?
Ah, wait just a moment, please...
This unit isn't complete yet.

It needs a few days of test operation and
tuning!

There's no time for that.
I'll break it in during real combat.

We've got an excellent mechanic of
our own, after all.
Chan, you're okay with that?
Yes, sir!

I won't know until I fly it. I'm heading
out--it'll double as a mobility test.

Lieutenant!
That's far too dangerous!
Lieutenant!!

I'm sorry... It's not that I don't
trust you people.

But the enemy won't wait... Could you do
whatever you can before I sortie?
Understood...

Machine added:
Re-GZ

rows.notes:
Amuro's rank (taii) rendered 'Captain' throughout this slice; Bright's kanchou also 'Captain' in other rows. | [editorial 1] 'performs almost exactly to the data' was ungrammatical-sounding | [editorial 23] system line aligned to the standard 'Machine added:
<name>' (brief)

segments.en:
Looks like the real fighting has
finally begun...
Have you seen any unusual movements?
Especially around Side 4...
Nothing worth mentioning so far.

If anything, what's strange is that the
Federation Forces at Side 4 still haven't
moved.

Seriously? The Earth's in danger, and
what are they doing?

Don't tell me they expect Londo Bell to
fight this alone.

Actually, that seems to be how things
stand.

What do you mean? Is the Federation
military that corrupt?
That's part of it...

But in space, resentment against the
Federation apparently runs pretty deep.

Neo Zeon's claims match what people
living in space think deep down.

That's why you get colonies like Sweetwater
cooperating fully with Neo Zeon.

You're saying colony citizens would accept
something like a meteor drop?

Seems we've ended up in that kind
of world.

(In the end, I still can't track
 Binzvanker's movements... Is he not in
 this world anymore?)

(But I can't just leave Neo Zeon's
 meteor drop alone either...)

rows.notes: Seg 15: Binzvanker is male per glossary. Thought lines keep the source's indent space after each line break. | [accuracy 11] senzaiteki = latent/deep-down, not 'secretly' (which implies consciously hidden) | [proofread 4] capitalisation: [jp] = 'Federation Forces' as everywhere else in these units

segments.en:
Yo! What's up?
Something on your mind?
Oh, Kaine...

Nah, Amuro's briefing the new pilots
right now, isn't he?

Oh, yeah, now that you mention it...
But those guys, the second it looked like
a battle might start...

...started grumbling and griping
right away, didn't they...
Yeah, exactly...
New soldiers have been assigned.
New MS have been deployed.

Listen! Quit coming up with nothing but
reasons why you of all people won't have
to fight a war!

But no matter how you look at it, there's
no way Char could've built up enough MS
and ships to wage a war!
That's because you lack imagination!

There are wars you can start without
building up your forces!
What do you mean?

He could get hold of nukes managed by the
Earth Federation government and slam them
into the Earth.

That's nonsense!
Nobody could ever pull that off!

Touching faith, but what guarantee is there
the Federation government keeps its nukes
under a perfect control system?

And who guaranteed there are no Neo Zeon
sympathizers in the Federation's space
forces?

There's also the option of dropping some
of the countless rocks within lunar orbit
onto the Earth.

The intel that the enemy's heading for
Fifth Luna makes that guess a certainty.

What are the odds they'll ram Fifth Luna
into a colony?

That's possible too, but dropping it on
Earth is easier.

Either way, Char isn't planning head-on
fleet or MS battles. But it's war all
the same.

If we just recognize a Neo Zeon government
at Sweetwater, isn't that the end of it?

Don't be stupid! Letting them play at
being the Zabi family again--what kind
of Spacenoid freedom is that?!
Don't talk nonsense!

If this is only about politics, I refuse
to take part in the war!

That's enough! This isn't some college
festival! Hold your debates after work!

You'll earn every cent of your peacetime
pay! Anyone who refuses will be
court-martialed!

The fleet's already on combat footing. All
of you stand by at Level 2 battle stations!
Stay sharp! That's all!
All rise! Dismissed!
Amuro, how'd it go?

Don't even ask. Those guys think the
military's some kind of co-op.
Lieutenant!

What?! There's no change to the
operation!

No, sir! I'd like to request combat
training before the operation!

Yeah, all right!
I'll be down in 10 minutes!

Sir!
Thank you, sir!

Kanji, you guys come along for the
training too!
Yeah, got it.
All right, let's go!
Yeah!

Kayra's MS Piloting level has
increased.

rows.notes: Segs 4-5: Kaine's sentence is split across two pages; kept the split. Segs 10, 15, 23-26 are several different unnamed Londo Bell members (24 rebuts 23, 25 rebuts 24); none gendered in English. Seg 29 'dai-ni sentou haichi' rendered 'Level 2 battle stations'. | [editorial 16] 'Nice faith' sounded off; 'Touching faith' carries Amuro's sarcasm (ii shinjin da ga)

segments.en:
The objective of this operation is to stop
the meteor drop on the Earth.

Given the current situation, the Neo Zeon
fleet is expected to use the resource
satellite Fifth Luna.

We'll head for Fifth Luna at once
and secure it.

I expect every one of you to give it
your all!

Whew... That wasn't much of a training
session.

The operation's close...
Can't be helped.

Before a battle, we need everyone
moving in step.

We couldn't take as much time as we'd
like, but it's a lot better than nothing...

Did you know, Lieutenant?
That Char was gonna make his move?

I did sense signs that he'd slipped
into Sweetwater.

Sweetwater's officials and citizens
were all hostile toward Londo Bell.

Yeah, no kidding~
They gave off a real nasty vibe~

But if there are people like that in other
colonies too... that's gonna be a real
pain...
Yeah...

With the Federation Forces as lax as they
are now, there must be quite a few small
colonies that have gone missing.

Char could use those as bases to rebuild
his army... That's entirely conceivable.
Really?

Yeah... The official view is that the
Island 1 types used before Sweetwater was
built were scrapped.
Whose official view?

The Earth Federation Forces'
Space Force General Staff.
Did they actually investigate it?

I suppose they did...
By computer.

Once the report of whoever checked it is
accepted by the computer, then that's
that--it becomes fact.

Did the person who accepted it actually
check it?

Who knows... But once it's accepted
somewhere, even something that exists can
be certified as nonexistent.
That's ridiculous!

"Computers don't lie," right? Once it's
input and approved, bureaucrats treat it
as fact.
Oh boy~ Is that how it works?
That's what bureaucrats do.

So that's why they've got no sense of
crisis... No wonder they got taken
advantage of.

(Sloppy oversight, huh...
 Neo Zeon's methods...
 Maybe they're the same as mine...)

(There's no way a mobile suit called
 Dragonar exists in this world...)
(And yet it just gets accepted...)

rows.notes: Seg 13: shima ichigou-gata rendered 'Island 1 types' (O'Neill Island One colony design). Seg 26: Light compares Neo Zeon exploiting sloppy records with his own way of getting Dragonar accepted; 'they' = Neo Zeon's methods, kept vague as in source. | [accuracy 28] tootte shimau = it passes/gets accepted, tying back to the juri (acceptance) talk; 'gets right through' read as physical

segments.en: We've entered Fifth Luna's sector.
Enemy fleet confirmed!
They're already deploying toward us!

Launch the MS teams!
We'll strike first!
So it's a fleet battle at last.

Hey, don't you think we're getting in
deeper and deeper?
It's too late to turn back now!

Right. All we can do now is push
forward.

Besides, we can't just let them drop
that thing on the Earth, can we?
Guess you've got a point...

All riiight!
Let's go, everyone!
The enemy fleet's charging in!

Right on the bearing the Colonel
predicted.

But for Londo Bell to get here this
quickly...

Could the enemy have learned of our
operation in advance?

That's simply the kind of opponent
Londo Bell is.

Still, if they'd known our movements
precisely, they could have moved sooner.

Colonel, shall I bring the Rewloola
forward?

No, the enemy MS teams are coming.
Send the Musaka fleet forward.

We'll launch our own MS teams at the
same time.
Understood.

I'm going to the MS deck. Captain Lyle,
I leave the rest to you.
Sir!
Nanai, keep me updated on the situation.
Understood!
Musaka, advance!!

Gyunei!
Can you launch?

Yes, sir,
I'm ready anytime!

Good,
we're launching the MS team!

Now then...
Let's see how much use this Jagd Doga's
power is in a fleet battle...

rows.notes: Seg 12: Lyle's line may be addressed to Char or Nanai; kept 'the Colonel' in the third person as in the source. | [accuracy 27] subject restored: Gyunei answering about himself | [accuracy 28] subject restored: the officer's ship is launching the MS team

segments.en: The Musaka's been destroyed?!
Gyunei, fall back.

The Musaka's been taken out! If I pull
back now, they'll break through!

Our reserve forces can buy time against
the enemy fleet.

More importantly,
some of the enemy MS have
latched onto Fifth.
Gyunei, guard Fifth's nuclear engines.
Roger!

We did it...
We drove off the enemy ships!

MS teams, finish resupplying while
you can.

Captain! Amuro's unit is already
heading for Fifth.

Understood.
Amuro can carry on as he is.
The rest of you, escort the Ra Cailum.
Roger!
Will I make it in time?!

Oh no...! Fifth is accelerating toward
the Earth!

It's no good... We can't stop a mass
like that.

Hey! There are still enemies out here!
Don't you dare let your guard down!

Fifth, entry angle good!
Velocity, good!

Colonel Char is on the MS deck,
correct?

Yes, ma'am.
He's in the Sazabi.

Colonel, Gyunei Guss's sector is at a
stalemate. I believe he needs support...

Fifth Luna has been sent on its way.
Give the signal for all units to withdraw!
I have, but...

With the mobile suits pulling back, we
can't disperse Minovsky particles to jam
radio waves.

Which puts Gyunei in that much more
danger, then...

Very well! Cover Gyunei's Jagd Doga!
I'll bring him back!

To think I couldn't stop this Fifth...
from falling to the Earth...!
Hm?!

Why drop something like this on
the Earth?!

It'll make the Earth go cold, and people
won't be able to live there!
It'll bring a nuclear winter!!

The people on Earth think of nothing but
themselves!

That's why I declared I would
wipe them out!!

For a human being to punish
other people...!

It is I, Char Aznable, who shall purge
them! Amuro!!
That's nothing but your ego!!

The time has come when the Earth can
hold out no longer!!

Gyunei,
we're heading back!

I can make it
on my own...

No, you can't.
It's obvious from out here.

You did well guarding Fifth Luna's
nuclear nozzles.
Let's go!
Sir!
Fifth is still falling toward the Earth!

You're still tracking the Neo Zeon fleet,
right?!
Yes, sir!

The attack on Fifth now passes to the
colony laser. We'll pursue the enemy
fleet!

Captain! Looks like there's been sabotage
at the colony!

The colony's laser attack
will be cut in half?
At that rate, it can't destroy Fifth...
Ngh...!

rows.notes: Seg 20: Nanai is female, so 'ma'am'. Seg 24: reading is that dispersing Minovsky particles would also block the withdrawal signal/retreat, so Gyunei can't be covered by jamming (source is terse). Seg 26 kaishuu suru = Char going to retrieve him himself (he is in the Sazabi), rendered 'I'll'. Seg 50: object 'it' made explicit as Fifth. | [accuracy 34] batsu wo ataeru = punish; 'pass judgment' softened it

segments.en: Pathetic!!

All I could do was watch Char
beat us!!

Neo Zeon... To think they had such a
huge force ready...

Even though we investigated every
single colony...

The Federation government runs space
from down on Earth, after all...

When Londo Bell goes in to investigate,
civilians like that end up shielding
them.

Soldiers we can handle, but our unit's
weak against civilians...

Are there really that many people who
hate the Federation?

Yeah...
Especially the people living in space...
...More importantly, Fifth fell.

Shouldn't we be rescuing the people
still on Earth?

Fifth alone can't freeze the Earth
completely.
Char's sure to make his next move soon.

I'm heading to the moon right now.
We're going to need the Gundam.

If all goes well, I can hit Char before
he gets back into Sweetwater!

Hey, wait,
Amuro!

Kanji!
I'm counting on you for a while.
Amuro has left the unit.

rows.notes: Seg 5: 'them' = Neo Zeon (who are shielded by sympathetic civilians); referent inferred from the previous line.
